help.intro: These badges show how translation keys relate to each other, so you can avoid entering the same text repeatedly.
help.aliasDescription: This key points to another key. Usually keep it as a pointer unless you need a page-specific override.
help.masterDescription: This key is the source for one or more alias keys. Translate this once per language and aliases can inherit it.
help.sharedDescription: This key is reused directly across multiple pages. Translate it once per language and all those pages use it.
help.ruleBody: Enter the translation once for the MASTER or SHARED key. Keep ALIAS keys as pointers unless you intentionally need an ALIAS override for page-specific wording.
